prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Mobile App', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'US-West', 'symptoms_observed': ['data mismatch', 'missing data'], 'reported_business_impact': 'low', 'reported_affected_users': 8, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Mobile App showing missing and mismatched data for specific users", "description": "Hello,\n\nWe have encountered an issue with our mobile application where several users (approximately 8) are reporting that their data is not displaying correctly. Specifically, some records appear to be missing entirely, while others show mismatched information compared to what is stored in the backend. This started happening in the production environment within the US-West region. The impact is currently considered low as it only affects a small subset of users, but we need assistance identifying the cause and restoring the correct data visibility. Please let us know if you need any specific user IDs or transaction logs to investigate further."}]}
